name: Amazon Visa

apr.notes: Purchase and balance transfer APR 18.99% to 27.74% variable based on creditworthiness; cash advance APR 28.74% variable; penalty APR up to 29.99%. Variable APRs are based on the 7.00% Prime Rate.

fx_fee.notes: Pricing & Terms list foreign transaction fees as None.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1% back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Amazon.com, Audible.com, Whole Foods Market and Chase Travel purchases
Gas stations, restaurants, and local transit and commuting (including rideshare)

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards can be redeemed at Amazon.com checkout with no minimum, or for cash back, gift cards and travel at Chase.com.

signup_bonus.description: $50 Amazon Gift Card loaded into the Amazon account Gift Card Balance on approval of the credit card application.

notes: Amazon Visa without a Prime membership requirement, distinct from the Prime Visa (us-chase-amazon-prime). Fees, APRs and earn rates come from the Chase product page and its Pricing & Terms page checked on the verification date. network_tier is recorded as none because neither the product page nor the Pricing & Terms page names the network package.
